title_en: vSFT: Learning to Verbally Tune Agents at Test Time
title_zh: vSFT：在测试时通过语言监督微调智能体
summary_en: The paper introduces vSFT, a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning framework that enables test-time weight updates for LLM agents using natural language feedback. A supervisor generates verbal supervision from failed trajectories, and a hypernetwork converts it into low-rank weight updates, forming a closed loop. On ALFWorld, vSFT with Qwen3-4B improves success rate by 8.7% over GRPO and 13.9% over Reflexion; on WebShop, by 4.8% and 18.2%, respectively. This test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms in-context and reinforcement learning baselines.
summary_zh: 本文提出vSFT（语言监督微调）框架，利用自然语言反馈在测试时对LLM智能体进行权重更新。监督器从失败轨迹生成语言监督，超网络将其转换为低秩权重更新，形成智能体与监督器之间的闭环。在ALFWorld上，使用Qwen3-4B的vSFT成功率比GRPO和Reflexion分别高8.7%和13.9%；在WebShop上分别高4.8%和18.2%。这种测试时参数内演化过程优于上下文方法和主流强化学习方法。
content_en: Large language model agents are increasingly improved via agentic reinforcement learning, which can be on-policy but suffers from expensive rollouts and sparse rewards, limiting its application at test time. In this paper, we present a verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning (vSFT) framework that enables the conjunction of dense feedback in natural language and weight updates at test time. Specifically, our vSFT forms a closed loop between an agent and a supervisor via a hypernetwork, in which the supervisor generates verbal supervision from the agent's failed trajectories, and the hypernetwork converts that supervision into low-rank weight updates to tune the agent. We validate that this test-time in-parameter evolving process outperforms both its in-context counterparts and prevalent reinforcement learning methods. In particular, our vSFT using Qwen3-4B outperforms GRPO and Reflexion by 8.7% and 13.9% in success rate on ALFWorld, and by 4.8% and 18.2% on WebShop, respectively. We believe that learning how to adapt a model, rather than an adapted model, offers a promising path towards more capable agents that improve themselves.
content_zh: 大型语言模型智能体正日益通过智能体强化学习得到改进，这类方法可以是在线策略的，但受限于昂贵的 rollout 和稀疏奖励，限制了其在测试时的应用。本文提出了一种言语监督微调（verbally Supervised Fine-Tuning, vSFT）框架，能够在测试时同时利用自然语言中的密集反馈和权重更新。具体而言，我们的 vSFT 通过一个超网络在智能体与监督者之间形成闭环，其中监督者根据智能体的失败轨迹生成言语监督，超网络将该监督转换为低秩权重更新以调优智能体。我们验证了这种测试时的参数内演化过程优于其上下文内对应方法以及主流的强化学习方法。特别是，我们的 vSFT 使用 Qwen3-4B 在 ALFWorld 上的成功率分别比 GRPO 和 Reflexion 高出 8.7% 和 13.9%，在 WebShop 上分别高出 4.8% 和 18.2%。我们相信，学习如何适配一个模型，而非一个已适配的模型，为构建能够自我改进的更强智能体提供了一条有前景的路径。
